title: Anatomical and Clinical Knowledge Graph for Physiological Data
text: Anatomical Clinical Knowledge Graph Physiological Data PhysioAnnotationHub lightweight, centralized annotation hub PhysioExperiment ecosystem. bundles curated anatomical ontology data – muscles, bones, nerves, clinical codes – exposes simple query interface traversable knowledge graph. package heavy dependencies (base R) designed imported ecosystem packages (PhysioMSKNet) need anatomical metadata knowledge graph enrichment without carrying data.

title: Anatomical and Clinical Knowledge Graph for Physiological Data
text: knowledge graph stores anatomical relationships subject-predicate-object triples (e.g., “biceps_brachii” – “originates_from” – “scapula”). supports SPARQL-like queries, graph traversal, shortest path computation, -representation analysis.

code: library(PhysioAnnotationHub)  # --- Load the annotation hub --- hub <- loadAnnotationHub() print(hub) #> PhysioAnnotationHub #>   Muscles: 320 entries #>   Bones:   206 entries #>   Nerves:  58 entries #>   ICD-10:  245 codes #>   ICF:     189 codes #>   KG:      1284 triples  # --- Query muscle annotations --- getMuscleAnnotation("biceps_brachii") #>             name          origin    insertion   innervation          action #> 1 biceps_brachii scapula (short) radius (tub) musculocutan elbow_flexion...  getMuscleAnnotation("quadriceps") # Returns all muscles matching the pattern  # --- Query bone annotations --- getBoneAnnotation("femur")  # --- Query nerve annotations --- getNerveAnnotation("median")  # --- Look up clinical codes --- getClinicalCodes("M54")        # ICD-10 dorsalgia codes getClinicalCodes("b710")       # ICF joint mobility  # --- Knowledge graph: find neighbors --- kgNeighbors("femur", radius = 1) #>           subject       predicate          object #> 1  vastus_medialis  originates_from         femur #> 2  vastus_lateralis originates_from         femur #> 3  rectus_femoris   inserts_on           patella #> ...  # --- Knowledge graph: shortest path --- kgShortestPath("scapula", "radius") #> scapula -> biceps_brachii -> radius  # --- Knowledge graph: SPARQL-like query --- queryKG(predicate = "innervated_by", object = "median_nerve")  # --- Knowledge graph: enrichment analysis --- my_muscles <- c("biceps_brachii", "brachialis", "pronator_teres") kgEnrichment(my_muscles, category = "innervation") #> Enriched for: musculocutaneous_nerve (p = 0.003), median_nerve (p = 0.012)

title: PhysioAnnotationHub 0.1.0
text: Initial release standalone package physio-ecosystem. Provides centralized anatomical clinical knowledge hub — muscle, bone, nerve metadata, clinical code mappings, queryable knowledge graph — bundled curated reference data downstream musculoskeletal rehabilitation analyses.

title: PhysioAnnotationHub 0.1.0
text: Muscle annotations (body region, primary/secondary action, innervating nerve, spinal level, muscle type, joint crossed). Bone annotations (body region, bone type, parent structure). Nerve annotations (spinal levels, type, body region, plexus). Clinical code tables mapping ICD-10 ICF codes affected/related muscles, body regions, functional domains. getMuscleAnnotation(), getBoneAnnotation(), getNerveAnnotation() retrieve records name, return full table called query. getClinicalCodes() resolves ICD-10 ICF codes referencing given set muscles. queryKG() filters triples combination subject, predicate, object using grep exact matching. kgNeighbors() returns triples within given number hops entity, following outgoing incoming edges. kgShortestPath() finds shortest path two entities via breadth-first search, reporting entity path, relations traversed (inverse edges flagged), path depth. kgEnrichment() performs -representation analysis muscle set full background, testing enrichment actions, innervation, body regions, spinal levels fold-enrichment hypergeometric p-values.
